# Site for sale

> Seek and Sell Auctioneers present this special parcel of land in West Wicklow to the market. Comprising of c.3.11 acres which is nestled in a secluded location. Accessed via private road and surrounded by a mixture of hard and softwood trees. There are stunning views of Lugnaquilla, privacy is in abundance and this opportunity to acquire land of this nature is rare.

## Fakta
- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Plocha: 12585.7 m²
- Energetická náročnost: Exempt
- Lokalita: Loughmouge Upper, Dunlavin
- Cena: 160 000 €
